about: Rules for the Bay Light Day Cruises retention pilot (FICTIONAL TEACHING BUSINESS). Plain JSON so it opens in any text editor. Change a number, save, and rerun. Each change is a Policy choice: note who changed what, and when, in changes_log.

scoring.about: Exposure score. More points means the booking is more likely to be changed or cancelled inside the free-cancellation window. These weights are a starting guess to test, not a prediction model.

rules.label: Booked more than 60 days before the trip
Booked through an online travel agency
Platform shows a price-alert flag (turn on only if your platform has one)

eligibility.about: Only the top share of open bookings by score enter the pilot. 0.10 means the top 10 percent.

holdout.about: Share of eligible bookings that get no pilot messages. 0.5 (50/50) is the recommendation for a pilot: an 80/20 split needs about 1.5 times as many bookings for the same answer. The seed makes the draw repeatable. Assignments are stored once in state/assignments.csv and never redrawn.

messages.about: Confidence first, discount last. Every treatment booking gets message A. At most one follow-up: B or C, tried in the order listed. B and C are promotional, so by default they go only to direct bookings (Contractual: check your OTA and hotel-desk agreements before sending promotions to their guests). Holdout bookings get no pilot messages but keep every normal service message (confirmation, safety, weather).
messages.lockin_terms_about: Message C is only drafted when the owner writes the exact terms here. Leave empty to never offer a lock-in. Never a competitor price match. For lodging, show the total price including mandatory fees (Legal mandate: 16 CFR Part 464).

checks.about: Local checks on every draft. A phrase is flagged only when it is not already in the approved facts, add-ons or owner terms.

power.about: Used by the report and the power command. Baseline = in-window change and cancellation rate without messages. Target = the rate you hope to reach.

changes_log.what: Starting rules for the fictional Bay Light pilot.
